objective: Extract structured entity data from saijaku-muhai-bahamut-main vol-01 to vol-05. Each volume step independently reads its split-text chapter files and writes period-based entity JSON files to its output directory.

steps.task:
Extract all entities from saijaku-muhai-bahamut-main vol-01.

SERIES: saijaku-muhai-bahamut-main
VOLUME: vol-01
WORLD: saijaku-muhai-bahamut
SPLIT_PATH: campaigns/world-library/worlds/saijaku-muhai-bahamut/sources/split-text/saijaku-muhai-bahamut-main/vol-01
OUTPUT_DIR: campaigns/world-library/manual-curation/saijaku-muhai-bahamut-output/waves/wave-001/vol-01
TEMPLATE_DIR: tools/p1-scan/_templates

Read SPLIT_PATH/chapters.json for chapter list, then read each chapter txt. Read each template from TEMPLATE_DIR before writing. Write all entity files to OUTPUT_DIR/{type}/{id}.json. Also write OUTPUT_DIR/world.json with world-level summary and OUTPUT_DIR/index.json listing all entities.

ALWAYS read the templates before writing so you know the fields.
